3.body: Select a file and press Space to preview it with Quick Look. Check contents without switching apps.

7.title: Switch views with {{shortcut}} · 2 · 3

8.title: Slack and GitHub with the same question
8.body: Connected data sources are searched alongside files. You can add or turn off sources anytime in Settings.

9.title: Reconfigure anytime with {{shortcut}}
9.body: Change folder scope, AI model, and data sources in Settings. Changing the embedding location will re-index from scratch.

reasons.keywordOnly: Keyword search only: this source is not embedded either.
reasons.mailcrawlIncompatible: mailcrawl only supports the built-in Qwen3 and cannot use an arbitrary HTTP embedding server.
reasons.mailcrawlPropagated: Records the embedding provider in connector.env (mailcrawl re-indexes automatically when the model changes).
reasons.obsidianIncompatible: qmd (obsidian) can only use local GGUF models, so it cannot use an HTTP embedding server.
reasons.obsidianPropagated: Sets QMD_EMBED_MODEL on the qmd child process and re-indexes with `qmd embed -f`.
reasons.discordIncompatible: This app cannot serve the Dazzi embedding runtime on loopback (not a public export). Choose an embedding server to pass it to discrawl.
reasons.discordPropagated: Rewrites the Dazzi-managed discrawl config and re-indexes with `discrawl embed --rebuild`.
reasons.kakaoSharedEmbedder: Kakao uses the shared Dazzi embedder through the sidecar over lazykatok's archive; changing the embedder re-embeds it on the next sync.
reasons.githubGistIncompatible: GitHubGistSkill is not a public @autorag/librarian export, so the app cannot set its embedder (fixed by the runtime gateway profile).
reasons.clawgalleryNotApplicable: ClawGallery is an image (VDR) index and does not use text embeddings.
reasons.larkNotApplicable: Lark uses only remote API search and refuses local embeddings.
reasons.defaultNotApplicable: This data source uses its own keyword/parse index and does not use the global embedder.
